svg.title: TabPFN v3.5 - classifier
svg.desc: Prior-Labs - one multitask checkpoint; three stages: per column, per row, in context · 219.0 M parameters. Symbols in shapes: B: ensemble members (batch); n: rows in the context (train + test); p: raw features; F: feature groups; n_test: test rows (the rows being predicted). Abbreviations: ICL: in-context learning: test rows attend to the labelled training rows; CLS: learned summary token that reads out a row or column; RoPE: rotary position embedding; MLP: multilayer perceptron (the feed-forward sublayer); GELU: Gaussian error linear unit (activation); LayerNorm: layer normalisation; RMSNorm: root-mean-square normalisation; QK: query and key (as in QK-norm); KV: keys and values (as in KV cache, KV heads); NaN: not-a-number: undefined values in the input; NA: missing values in the input; ECDF: empirical cumulative distribution function. How to read: each table: training rows above, test rows below, columns across; attention across rows, within a column; the arrow points from the test rows to the training rows they read; attention across columns or features, within a row; inducing points: a small learned set that summarises the rows; outlined cells: an embedding, where every cell becomes a vector; the prediction for the test rows; one wide column: after this point the table's columns are merged into one vector per row; × N: the block is stacked N times; over rows / columns / features: the axis this block's attention runs across; right columns: the tensor shape each stage emits, then its exact parameter count.
svg.text: Prior-Labs - one multitask checkpoint; three stages: per column, per row, in context · 219.0 M parameters
per column, each cell's midrank against the training rows, via 8192 bucket
Fourier bank (32 frequencies) over 3 values + linear over 30 metadata
induced self-attention, 128 inducing vectors; keys are training rows only
pre-norm self-attention with RoPE and QK-norm; last block reads out 8 CLS
pre-norm, QK-norm; 16 heads of 64; test rows read 1 KV head; MLP 1024 -> 2048
retrieval over the training labels, 6 heads of 64; up to 160 classes
present in the checkpoint and loaded, but the task selects the other branch
in-context learning: test rows attend to the labelled
learned summary token that reads out a row or column
keys and values (as in KV cache, KV heads)
